title: Verify no SIGSEGV crash on game start and during gameplay
description: Ensure the game does not crash with SIGSEGV error caused by improper access to shared values during component render or hooks execution.

steps.description: Launch the application on supported devices.
Start a new game in both Classic (8x8) and Chaos (10x10) modes.
Play the game performing drag-and-drop block placements continuously for at least 10 minutes.
Observe that the app remains stable without any crash, specifically no SIGSEGV or memory access violations occur.

title: Validate useAnimatedReaction hooks replace direct shared value access
description: Verify that all modified components properly use useAnimatedReaction hooks to manage shared values and no direct .value access is done during render or useEffect causing side effects.

steps.description: Inspect component behavior of EnhancedGame, Game, BlockGrid, and HandPieces during runtime.
Confirm the components consume shared values only via useAnimatedReaction hooks and no direct .value read occurs in render or useEffect.
Verify correct rendering of game grid and hand piece states without flickering or stale data.

title: Test EnhancedGame component modal state management and game service integration
description: Verify that the modal states (e.g., game over, pause) and game service integration in EnhancedGame component behave correctly after fixing state management.

steps.description: Start a game in EnhancedGame component.
Trigger modal states by finishing a game and pausing the game.
Confirm modals display with correct state and update promptly without stale or incorrect states.
Verify game service integrations such as scoring and state updates happen correctly without delay.

title: Verify BlockGrid component renders correctly with optimized state management
description: Ensure BlockGrid renders all blocks correctly reflecting current game state with optimizations applied using useAnimatedReaction.

steps.description: Launch game and enter a game mode.
Place various block shapes on the grid to trigger line breaks and combo scoring.
Verify grid components update correctly without rendering glitches or stale block states.
Confirm board length and block element states are consistent with game logic.

title: Test HandPieces component updates with useAnimatedReaction hooks
description: Ensure that the hand pieces state updates correctly on block placement and refreshes without errors or inconsistencies after applying improved state management.

steps.description: Start the game and observe the initial hand pieces loaded.
Place blocks from the hand pieces onto the grid repeatedly.
Verify that hand pieces update in real-time and reflect the correct count and shapes without errors.

title: Ensure Game component stability with fixed useEffect dependencies
description: Validate that Game component does not exhibit unstable behavior or crashes due to improper useEffect dependencies or shared value access.

steps.description: Initiate multiple game sessions on various supported devices.
Perform normal and rapid gameplay interactions.
Confirm no runtime errors, warnings, or crashes occur in console or logs related to Game component hooks.

title: Check UI responsiveness and animation smoothness during drag-and-drop
description: Verify that drag-and-drop block placement animations remain smooth and responsive with the updated shared value management.

steps.description: Start a game and perform repeated drag-and-drop of blocks from hand pieces to grid.
Confirm animations are smooth at 60fps target without jitter or lag across supported devices.

title: Test error handling when shared values are being updated concurrently
description: Simulate scenarios where multiple components update shared values simultaneously to verify app handles concurrency safely without crashes or inconsistent UI.

steps.description: Trigger multiple concurrent updates to game state and shared values by rapid user inputs and game logic triggers.
Observe for any race conditions, UI glitches, or application crashes.

title: Validate no regressions in overall game functionality after code changes
description: Run comprehensive gameplay scenarios covering block placement, line breaks, combos, score updates and transitions between game states to ensure no regressions introduced by the refactor/code fixes.

steps.description: Play through Classic and Chaos modes including multiple rounds.
Complete levels triggering combos and line breaks.
Verify scoring accuracy, UI updates, and game logic correctness remain consistent with product requirements.
